scope: Redesign the agent feedback loop (aes-learning-loop) as an Observation-to-Action case: agents report provenanced observations/claims/actions in their Feedback section; the loop extracts, sorts (System 1), analyses recurring problems, turns licensed claims into enforced rules or checks, and measures whether the failure stops recurring.

fact_evidence.existing_implementation_obstacle: The current collector, learned skill and weekly labeller run; they are inputs to change, not the obstacle (AES #156-#233).
fact_evidence.reproduced_failure: This is a design change, not a fix to a reproduced fault.
fact_evidence.identified_fix: No accepted design yet; the record model is the open question.
fact_evidence.concurrent_writers: Other sessions changed the learned skill, the Feedback closeout rule and AES planning on 2026-10-07 (AGENTS.md Feedback field; learned SKILL.md).
fact_evidence.machine_consumed_planning_handoff: The plan is read by Brian and agents, not consumed by a machine.
fact_evidence.shared_contract_mutation: Changes the Feedback closeout contract in AGENTS.md and the learned skill every agent uses.
fact_evidence.persistent_migration: 68 existing feedback issues (32 lesson, 25 friction, 11 problem) and the legacy register would be relabelled into the new model.
fact_evidence.governed_registry: The feedback record and the failure-mode taxonomy (docs/failure-modes.md) are governed registers.
fact_evidence.consequential_external_mutation: Where the log lives decides whether private transcript quotes become public (AES repository is PUBLIC; issue #242).
fact_evidence.answer_only: Brian, 2026-10-07: 'lets plan this out using company planning'.
fact_evidence.continuity_beyond_session: Brian approved a plan spanning multiple build steps after vision milestone 4.
fact_evidence.one_writer: Several sessions write AES and project-meta concurrently (claims list, 2026-10-07).
fact_evidence.reversible: Design and relabelling add comments and new records; nothing is deleted.
fact_evidence.boundary_known: The record model, the O2A relation mapping and the log's visibility are still open.

rationale: Shared contract, governed registers, a migration and a public/private boundary with concurrent writers select the coordinated path.
